metricDefinitions.colorRatio: opaqueColorCount divided by visiblePixels, rounded to six decimals.
metricDefinitions.opaqueBounds: Smallest local rectangle containing pixels with alpha greater than zero.
metricDefinitions.opaqueColorCount: Number of distinct RGB values among pixels with alpha greater than zero.
metricDefinitions.pixelSha256: SHA-256 of row-major raw RGBA bytes for the measured rectangle.
metricDefinitions.singletonRatio: Visible pixels whose RGB occurs exactly once divided by visiblePixels, rounded to six decimals.
metricDefinitions.transparentRgbNonZeroPixels: Alpha-zero pixels whose RGB channels are not all zero.
